trace.purpose: Find the model year and powertrain combination with the highest total warranty cost per vehicle delivered, including those with no claims

WITH warranty_costs AS (
  SELECT v.model_year, v.powertrain, COALESCE(SUM(wc.cost_eur), 0) AS total_warranty_cost
  FROM gishub.fleet.vehicles v
  LEFT JOIN gishub.fleet.warranty_claims wc ON v.vin = wc.vin
  GROUP BY v.model_year, v.powertrain
),
vehicle_counts AS (
  SELECT model_year, powertrain, COUNT(*) AS vehicle_count
  FROM gishub.fleet.vehicles
  GROUP BY model_year, powertrain
)
SELECT wc.model_year, wc.powertrain, (wc.total_warranty_cost / vc.vehicle_count) AS avg_warranty_cost_per_vehicle
FROM warranty_costs wc
JOIN vehicle_counts vc ON wc.model_year = vc.model_year AND wc.powertrain = vc.powertrain
ORDER BY avg_warranty_cost_per_vehicle DESC
LIMIT 1
